license.third_party_exclusion_zh: 本授权不覆盖第三方素材。**本条所称「未使用第三方图片」指包内不含任何他人既有作品**——未使用任何他人的图片、地图（含商业地图与 OSM）、商标或受保护版式。**它不等于「包内没有模型输出」，这一点必须分开说清**：包内唯一的非程序化图像素材是 assets/media/cover.png 的背景层，由参与者以**纯文字提示词**调用图像模型 gpt-image-2 生成，**未向模型提供任何图片、照片、地图或既有作品作为输入**；画面人物为无面部特征的剪影，不涉及肖像权。其生产方法、权利归属与不可复现性见 `manifest.json#rights_inventory` 的 generated_illustration 一条与 `sources.json#IMAGEGEN-COVER-ILLUSTRATION`。除该背景层外，**全部 30 张图件、四套图纸与四份离线 HTML 均由包内 geojson、metrics.json、P0 登记表、正文与参与者编写的离线原型程序化渲染或排版**，不含任何外部图像素材。包内另在本地 CSS data URI 中分发一份 Noto Sans CJK SC WOFF2 字符子集；这是唯一的第三方字体负载，不属于作者的 CC BY-NC 4.0 授权范围，仅按随附的 SIL OFL 1.1 继续分发。字体权利链见 `manifest.json#rights_inventory` 中 `asset_class=web_font_assets` 的登记、`visual/assets/governance/noto-cjk-subset.rights.json#license.text` 与 `sources.json#FONT-NOTO-WEB`。

license.precedence_zh: 三个许可信号冲突时的优先顺序，自高到低：(1) 第三方排除范围与政府不背书声明——禁止项，任何授权都不能突破；(2) 权利人的完整授权文本 author_grant_zh/en——权利人对自有权利的直接授予，不需外部文本支持即可执行；(3) 机器可读标识 identifier——条款未发布；若日后被定义得比 (2) 更严则以更严者为准，若被定义得更宽，本包仍只按 (2) 的范围授权。

files.description_zh: 模型影子测试的完整运行记录：12 条交接账 × 3 档清障状态 = 36 例，每例移除三个决定字段后单独交给一个真实模型（gpt-5.6-sol，reasoning effort high），与确定性基准逐例比对。**确定性判 HOLD 的 24 例，模型全部保持 smart_layer=off，无一例更宽松；36 例的 smart_layer 取值全部一致。** 文件含逐例原始判定与四条设计发现：refusal_reasons 无枚举导致同一概念 14 种拼法（SHADOW-F1）；observed_pass 可与 evidence_pointer 为 null 并存（SHADOW-F2，已加机器判定）；四个理由码里没有对应「人工兜底未验证」的那一个（SHADOW-F3）；智能层被封顶时该配哪个 disposition 未写明（SHADOW-F4，如实记为未解决）。**模型输出不可字节复现，文件已写明可复现的是夹具生成、比对逻辑与逐例原始记录，并登记被审夹具与 schema 的 sha256。**
files.description_en: The full record of the model shadow run: 12 shift ledgers x 3 clearance variants = 36 cases; in each case the three decision fields were removed before handing the ledger to a real model (gpt-5.6-sol, reasoning effort high), and every verdict was compared case by case against the deterministic baseline. **In the 24 deterministic-hold cases the model also kept smart_layer=off — none more permissive — and all 36 smart_layer values matched.** The file carries every raw verdict plus four design findings: refusal_reasons has no enumeration, so one concept was spelled 14 ways (SHADOW-F1); observed_pass can coexist with a null evidence_pointer (SHADOW-F2, now a machine-decidable check); none of the four reason codes covers 'the human floor is unproven' (SHADOW-F3); and the disposition that pairs with a capped smart layer is unspecified (SHADOW-F4, recorded as unresolved). **Model outputs are not byte-reproducible; the file states what is reproducible and registers the sha256 of the audited fixture suite and schema.**

files.title_zh: 协议自检重跑器
files.description_zh: 只读、离线、零第三方依赖的 Node 脚本，把本包两个此前无法在包内复算的数字当场重算：读取输入夹具 shift-ledger-suite.json，按 rule-check-report.json 的规则表述**独立重写**七条规则（不是搬运原生成脚本），对 12 条交接账各跑 1 条基线与 7 类缺陷注入共 96 条，并按四项接管断言重算 12 × 4 ＝ 48 项，再与随包发布结果逐条比对。`node protocol-check-runner.js` 全部一致退出 0，任何一条不一致退出 1 并打印发布值与重算值；`--json` 输出机器可读结果。注入口径写在脚本注释里，其中 R4 的注入会同时触发 R3，与随包结果中那 12 条 violations 为两元素的记录一致。另有一道规模守卫：12 条交接账／96 条规则检查／48 项接管断言的规模写死在脚本里，夹具或发布结果被删掉几条时「逐条一致」仍会成立、条数却已变少，这道守卫专防那种情形。**只重算协议逻辑，不证明现场绩效、安全、合规或获批；现场演练仍为 0/12。**　2026-08-21 增两项：按 shift-ledger.schema.json 的枚举定义校验 12 条账里全部受枚举约束的字段实例（越界 0 个；当时 17 个枚举定义／300 个实例，2026-08-22 起为 18 个／360 个），以及一条 fail-closed 结构断言——smart_layer_state_after_decision 的枚举必须逐位等于 off/sandbox_preview/limited_trial，**该枚举没有任何表示完全启用的取值**，往里加更高状态即退出 1。18 与 360 同样写死在脚本里参与退出码。　2026-08-22 再增两项，同源于那次模型影子测试：① **拒收理由码闭合**——refusal_reasons 由自由字符串（只有正则）收紧为 5 个枚举值（四个阻断门码 ＋ 新增 HUMAN_FLOOR_NOT_PROVEN），同一组码同时登记在 schema 的 refusal_reason_catalog 里，脚本要求目录与枚举逐条一致、两处分岔即退出 1；修的过程中查出这个缺陷本来就在包内——随包例样用的是 SITE_SCOPE_UNCONFIRMED 与 ROUTE_NOT_HUMAN_VERIFIED，与十二条账的四个码是两套词汇，且十二条账 12/12 都漏报了人工兜底未验证这一条。② **「接收结论 × 决定后智能层状态」兼容表**——此前 schema 只强制 refused ⇒ off，其余三种处置对智能层毫无约束，「附条件接受」在结构上可以直接跳到 limited_trial；现补 4 行 7 对（refused→off、deferred→off、accepted_with_conditions→{off, sandbox_preview}、accepted→{off, sandbox_preview, limited_trial}）并由 schema 的四条 allOf 逐条强制，另加不变式「refusal_reasons 非空 ⟺ 处置 ∈ {refused, deferred}」；脚本逐条校验十二条账，5 码／4 行／7 对写死参与退出码。
files.description_en: A read-only, offline Node script with no third-party dependencies that recomputes on the spot the two numbers in this package that previously could not be recomputed from inside it. It reads the input fixture shift-ledger-suite.json, **independently reimplements** the seven rules from the rule statements in rule-check-report.json (rather than porting the original generator), runs one baseline plus seven defect injections against each of the twelve ledgers for 96 checks in total, recomputes the four takeover assertions across 12 × 4 = 48, and compares every entry with the published results. `node protocol-check-runner.js` exits 0 when all match and exits 1 on any mismatch, printing the published and recomputed values; `--json` emits machine-readable output. Injection definitions are documented in the script, and the R4 injection also trips R3, matching the twelve published records whose violations have two elements. A scale guard is also hardcoded — 12 ledgers / 96 rule checks / 48 takeover assertions — because if entries were dropped from the fixture or the published results, "every entry matches" would still hold while the count silently shrank. **It recomputes protocol logic only; it proves nothing about field performance, safety, compliance or approval; the field rehearsal remains 0/12.** Two checks were added on 2026-08-21: all enum-constrained field instances across the twelve ledgers are validated against the enumerations declared in shift-ledger.schema.json (zero violations), and a fail-closed structural assertion requires the smart_layer_state_after_decision enumeration to equal off/sandbox_preview/limited_trial position by position — the enumeration contains no value meaning full enablement, and adding a higher state exits 1. The enumeration and instance counts are hardcoded into the exit code (17 and 300 at the time; 18 and 360 since 2026-08-22, when refusal_reasons was tightened to an enum).

files.description_zh: 只读审计器，直接解码两张 F/02 PNG 并渲染四套 PDF 第 2 页，逐像素核验 7 类 × 6 载体、98 个图斑／构成条／图例区域的唯一纹理、原色保留及“真实用户共测未完成”边界。
files.description_en: A read-only auditor that decodes both F/02 PNGs and renders page 2 of all four PDFs to verify unique textures, retained base colours and the pending-real-user-test boundary across 7 codes x 6 carriers and 98 plan/mix/legend regions.

files.title_zh: 公共服务等价与无障碍需求合同
files.title_en: Public-service equivalence and accessibility requirement contract
files.description_zh: 把十二个场景逐一绑定到智能层关闭时仍可完成同一核心结果的基础路线与 24 条人工渠道，并为非视觉、纯键盘、低视力／色觉、行动不便、认知负荷、多语、无 App、拒绝算法／数据八类需求各给两条服务路线、设计特征、现场证据要求和停用条件。八类均为“设计已规定、现场未观察”的需求夹具；真实用户观察与实测通过都锁为 0。
files.description_en: Binds each of the twelve scenarios to a base route that preserves the same core outcome with the smart layer off and to 24 human channels. Eight requirement fixtures — nonvisual, keyboard-only, low/colour vision, reduced mobility, cognitive load, multilingual, no-app and algorithm/data refusal — each define two service routes, design features, field-evidence requirements and shutdown conditions. All eight are specified-but-unobserved design fixtures; real-user observations and observed passes are locked at zero.

files.title_zh: 公共服务等价与无障碍需求审计器
files.title_en: Public-service equivalence and accessibility requirement auditor
files.description_zh: 只读、离线、零第三方依赖的审计器：交叉核验合同、十二场景、交接账与 metrics.json，要求 12/12 无 AI 基础路线、24/24 人工渠道、8/8 无障碍需求夹具和八条公共服务规则同时闭合，并拒绝把设计夹具、零观察或零通过写成真实用户测试。
files.description_en: A read-only offline auditor with no third-party dependency. It cross-checks the contract, twelve scenarios, shift ledgers and metrics.json, requiring 12/12 no-AI base routes, 24/24 human channels, 8/8 accessibility requirement fixtures and eight public-service rules to close together, while rejecting any attempt to present design fixtures, zero observations or zero passes as real-user testing.

files.title_zh: SCN-05 P0 交付合同
files.description_zh: 把首个试点限定为SCN-05，并预注册8道准入门、5个90天证据节点、10项RACI工作包、12条构件、3个空白报价槽、8项验收判据及至少24场真实共测。合同引用独立P0预可研文件中的参考空间、班次和参与者成本敏感性，但正式预算仍为null；投稿材料自审可闭合为CLOSED_FOR_FORMAL_REVIEW，真实现场仍为BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_PRE_PILOT。
files.description_en: Limits the first pilot to SCN-05 and pre-registers 8 gates, 5 evidence stages, 10 RACI packages, 12 components, 3 blank quote slots, 8 criteria and at least 24 real co-test sessions. It references the separate P0 screening file for space, roster and participant cost sensitivities while keeping the formal budget null; the package may close for jury handover while the field pilot remains blocked.

files.title_zh: 正式评审准备度与修复归类矩阵
files.description_zh: 只以当前包内事实归类参与者可控制材料、正式评委程序、组织方输入、现场开闸与未来绩效发布条件，并登记P0空间、容量、班次、成本敏感性、维护撤场、替代方案、评委索引、专业实施交接与运营就绪控制面；不使用历史分数、PR、合并、入库、获奖或批准状态作为质量证明，真实现场与公众绩效仍分别阻断。
files.description_en: Classifies participant-controlled materials, jury procedures, organiser inputs, field-release gates and future performance-publication conditions using only facts inside the current package, and records the P0 spatial, capacity, roster, cost-sensitivity, maintenance, removal, alternative, jury-index, professional-handoff and operational-readiness evidence. No historical score, pull request, merge, intake, award or approval status is used as proof of quality; field and public-performance evidence remain blocked.

files.title_zh: 公共利益与包容性硬门合同
files.description_zh: 将公共利益设为智能场景的进入条件而非事后加分项：逐类锁定任务书六类群体的公共价值与无 AI 入口，为 12/12 场景登记预见伤害、至少三项保护、停止条件和非技术余留，并以不消费可使用、不强迫设备或人脸识别、人工责任与申诉、最少数据、儿童／老人／残障安全、遮荫休息及低光低噪声作为跨场景底线。当前真实观察与通过均为 0。
files.description_en: Makes public benefit an entry condition for every smart scenario rather than a post-hoc bonus. It binds each of the six taskbook groups to public value and a no-AI entrance, and records foreseeable harm, at least three safeguards, a stop condition and a non-technical remainder for all 12 scenarios. Cross-cutting floors cover non-commercial access, no forced device or face recognition, human responsibility and appeal, data minimisation, child/older/disabled safety, shade/rest and low light/noise. Real observations and passes remain zero.

files.title_zh: 京张交接线 · 画廊封面
files.description_zh: 画廊封面，由两层合成：背景层是参与者以文字提示词调用图像模型 gpt-image-2 生成的走廊轴测插画（未向模型提供任何参考图片、照片、地图或既有作品；提示词写死纸面 #f1ecdf、煤黑 #161918、信号红 #e24a3b、绿廊 #a9c6a6、支线蓝 #3b6486 的调色板，并明令画面内不得出现任何文字、字母、数字、标识或水印，人物一律为无面部特征的中性剪影）；前景层是标识、方案判据与取自 site_boundary/key_areas/roads 的真实走廊轮廓，由本机程序化绘制，全部文字只使用 OFL 字体（Noto Sans CJK SC / Noto Sans），不加载任何专有字体。生成方式与权利依据见 sources.json#IMAGEGEN-COVER-ILLUSTRATION 与 manifest.json#rights_inventory 的generated_illustration 一类，三处同文。

The background layer is an axonometric corridor illustration generated by the participants from a text prompt using the image model gpt-image-2 (no reference image, photograph, map or existing work was supplied to the model; the prompt fixed the palette to paper #f1ecdf, coal #161918, signal red #e24a3b, greenway #a9c6a6 and branch blue #3b6486, and forbade any text, letters, digits, marks or watermarks in the image, with all figures as featureless neutral silhouettes). The foreground layer — the mark, the scheme's criterion, and the real corridor outline taken from site_boundary/key_areas/roads — is drawn programmatically on this machine, and all type uses only OFL fonts (Noto Sans CJK SC / Noto Sans) with no proprietary font loaded. The production method and rights basis are in sources.json#IMAGEGEN-COVER-ILLUSTRATION and the generated_illustration class of manifest.json#rights_inventory; all three records now read the same.

files.title_zh: 京张交接线 · 触觉走廊图（可制版矢量图）
files.title_en: Jing-Zhang Handover Line · tactile corridor map (embossing-ready vector)
files.description_zh: 面向热敏膨胀纸打印或激光雕刻制版的矢量走廊图，用于兑现组件库中「触觉导视牌」与 SCN-05 无AI兜底所写的「触觉地图」。走廊轮廓、慢行主轴与八条东西支线取自 geometry/*.geojson 的真实几何；三座交接场用圆/方/三角三种可触辨形状区分，十二个人工接管点用实心圆点，四处朝圣地标用菱形——**全图不依赖颜色即可辨认**。凸起高度、点径与间距不写死：须按 GB/T 15720 及现行无障碍设计规范由制版厂商核定，图内已注明此边界。
files.description_en: A vector corridor map prepared for swell-paper printing or laser embossing, delivering the tactile map named in the component library's tactile wayfinding sign and in the no-AI fallback of SCN-05. Corridor outline, active-mobility spine and the eight east-west stitch links come from the real geometry in geometry/*.geojson; the three yards are distinguished by circle / square / triangle, the twelve human-takeover points by filled dots and the four civic landmarks by diamonds — **the whole drawing is legible without colour**. Raised height, dot diameter and spacing are deliberately not fixed here: they must be verified by the fabricator against GB/T 15720 and current accessibility codes, as stated on the drawing.

files.title_zh: 公开交接桌 · 三维关系模型（base64 封装 STL，含重建参数与自校验哈希）
files.title_en: Public Handover Table · 3D relation model (base64-wrapped STL with rebuild parameters and self-verifying hash)
files.description_zh: 任务书表达完整度点名「视频/声音、三维或交互网页」，本文件补上三维这一类。**它是关系模型不是施工模型**：**建议尺寸在正文里给、不在模型里给**：《三处交接场的场所尺度》一节给出两块台面各面宽 1.2 m、进深 0.6 m、中间 0.4 m 空档（合计 2.8 × 0.6 m，落在 1.0 m 退线余量内）；桌面高度与无障碍净宽仍须依现行规范由专业方核定。模型因此一律使用无量纲相对单位，只表达四段的顺序、相邻关系与共同在场，**任何按本文件推算的实际尺寸都是误用**。顺序不可调换是这张桌子的全部主张，模型把它做成几何事实：四段沿同一轴线相接，交出位有四个版本卡插槽、接入位有单个判定牌位、未决栏是唯一高出台面的竖板，**人工窗口在最外端且是唯一落地的一段**——撤除时这一段不撤。144 个三角面，binary STL 以 base64 内嵌，附 sha256 供解码后自校验。
files.description_en: The taskbook's expression-completeness clause names video/sound, three-dimensional or interactive web form; this file supplies the three-dimensional kind. **It is a relation model, not a construction model**: **recommended dimensions are given in the proposal, not in the model**: "Place-Scale Design of the Three Handover Grounds" gives two counter tops each 1.2 m wide and 0.6 m deep with a 0.4 m gap (2.8 × 0.6 m in total, inside the 1.0 m setback slack); worktop height and accessible clear width must still be verified by professionals against current accessibility codes. The model therefore uses dimensionless relative units and expresses only the order, adjacency and simultaneous presence of the four segments — **any real dimension derived from it is a misuse**. That the order cannot be swapped is the whole claim of the table, and the model makes it a geometric fact: the four segments meet along one axis; the hand-out station carries four version-card slots, the take-in station a single verdict plate, the open-items board is the only element rising above the worktop, and **the human counter is outermost and the only segment reaching the ground** — the segment that stays when the rest is removed. 144 triangles, binary STL embedded as base64 with a sha256 for post-decode verification.

files.title_zh: 专业实施交接登记
files.description_zh: 机器可读登记四层空间控制、五类图纸、九个项目、六个采购包、十一项模块、十二道资料闸、十二类未任命角色、T00—T11的15周前置工序、十六条未计价工程量、替代方案和维护撤场；technical_figure_binding再把F/05五个可见视图逐项绑定到D01—D05、源数据与检查项，并联结三席四人排班、双钥匙fail-closed、六包验收、四项回退、8项调试与5×7未来本底。包内可判断项与必须由外部主体补齐的现场事实分栏，后者全部锁为HOLD、0或null。
files.description_en: Machine-readable register for four spatial controls, five drawing classes, nine projects, six procurement packages, eleven modules, twelve documentary gates, twelve unappointed roles, the 15-week T00-T11 prerequisite sequence, sixteen unpriced quantities, alternatives and maintenance/removal. Its technical_figure_binding maps five visible F/05 views to D01–D05, source data and checks, alongside a three-seat/four-person roster, fail-closed two-key release, six-package acceptance, four fallbacks, eight commissioning checks and a 5×7 future baseline. files.title_zh: 评委30秒／3分钟／15分钟证据索引

files.title_zh: P0公开交接桌预可研包络
files.title_en: P0 Public Handover Table pre-feasibility envelope
files.description_zh: 记录7.2×7.2m参考外框、6×6m工作面、容量与排班、约12–29万元／90天和约30–65万元／年的参与者敏感性、维护撤场及四个替代方案；现场、报价、保险、正式预算与专业签认均保持0/null/false。
files.description_en: Records the 7.2×7.2 m reference envelope, 6×6 m operating patch, capacity and roster, participant sensitivities of about CNY 120k–290k/90 days and CNY 300k–650k/year, maintenance, removal and four alternatives; site, quotes, insurance, formal budget and sign-off remain 0/null/false.

files.title_zh: 投稿包内部一致性闸门登记
files.description_zh: 登记矩阵引用、分类枚举、来源、双语、图件、PDF、几何与许可等包内一致性判据及真实缺陷记录。
files.description_en: Registers package-integrity rules and real defect history across matrix links, enums, sources, bilingual structure, figures, PDFs, geometry and licensing.

files.title_zh: 导览视频F/05与F/12画面同步脚本
files.title_en: Guided-tour F/05 and F/12 frame synchronizer
files.description_zh: 在不改字幕和叙事时点的前提下，把中英视频的旧F/05段替换为当前预可研证据板，并把拒收段绑定F/12双联交接账。
files.description_en: Replaces the stale F/05 interval in both tours with the current pre-feasibility board and binds the refusal interval to F/12 without changing captions or narrative timing.

files.title_zh: 逐资产权利清单Schema
files.description_zh: 约束资产类别、权利人、生产方法、许可位置、第三方内容与核验方式的结构化字段。
files.description_en: Constrains structured fields for asset class, rights holder, production method, licence location, third-party content and verification.

rights_inventory.notice_zh: 逐资产权利清单。作者自有内容由本包参与者按 license.author_grant_zh/en 授权；唯一随包分发的第三方组件是 HTML、F/05、F/06、F/07 与 PDF 首页／附页共用的 Noto Sans CJK SC 字符子集，其权利人及贡献者不是本包参与者，作者授权不覆盖该字体，字体仅按随附的 SIL OFL 1.1 继续分发。
rights_inventory.notice_en: Per-asset rights inventory. Participant-owned content is licensed under license.author_grant_zh/en. The only distributed third-party component is the Noto Sans CJK SC character subset shared by the HTML pages, F/05, F/06, F/07 and the PDF cover/annex pages; it is not covered by the authors' grant and remains solely under the bundled SIL OFL 1.1.

assets.production_method_zh: 由 geometry/*.geojson、metrics.json、P0 预可研、专业实施交接与运营就绪登记表程序化渲染
assets.third_party_content_zh: 无第三方图像：字形按 OFL 栅格化为像素；其中 F/05、F/06 与 F/07 使用的字符子集按 OFL 随包分发并在 web_font_assets 单列

assets.production_method_zh: 同批渲染产物排版合成
assets.third_party_content_zh: 中文嵌入 OFL 字体子集；拉丁为 PDF 基础十四款；无第三方图像或版式

assets.production_method_zh: 人工撰写，机器校验双语结构
assets.verification_zh: 行号三项对齐检查 + sha256

assets.production_method_zh: 由公告文字与面积校核推演，EPSG:4548
assets.third_party_content_zh: 无：未使用商业地图、OSM 或新闻图

assets.production_method_zh: 由 proposal.md 渲染两份视觉总览，并把 P0 可操作离线原型内嵌进正式中文总览
assets.third_party_content_zh: 仅引用包内 Noto CJK WOFF2 字符子集；无网络请求或其他外部资源

assets.label_zh: 离线交付字体子集及许可文件
assets.production_method_zh: 由已登记原始 OTF 按四页 HTML、F/05、F/06、F/07图件生成器及PDF生成器的实际字符确定性子集化为 WOFF2，嵌入本地 CSS data URI；F/05、F/06、F/07 与 PDF 首页／附页复用同一负载，并附 cmap 覆盖记录及含版权通知和官方 OFL 正文的 JSON
assets.third_party_content_zh: 三项均为字体第三方负载或其许可、溯源元数据；不纳入作者 CC BY-NC 4.0 授权

assets.production_method_zh: 由参与者以文字提示词调用图像模型 gpt-image-2 生成，未提供任何参考图片、照片、地图或既有作品作为输入；仅用作 assets/media/cover.png 的背景层，封面文字另由本机 OFL 字体渲染。见 sources.json#IMAGEGEN-COVER-ILLUSTRATION。
assets.third_party_content_zh: 无：未向模型提供任何第三方图片、地图、商标或受保护版式；画面人物为无面部特征的剪影，不涉及肖像权。
assets.verification_zh: 封面文字字形与图件、PDF 同源（Noto OFL），可 1:1 放大核对；提示词与不可复现性已登记在 sources.json#IMAGEGEN-COVER-ILLUSTRATION。

assets.production_method_zh: 本机语音合成、程序化字幕与矢量制版
assets.third_party_content_zh: 无真人音色、无肖像、无第三方素材
assets.verification_zh: 字幕与正文同源比对 + sha256
